decision_summary: Approve QIF v0.6.25 Evaluator Packet CLI for release.
rationale: Visionary: evaluator-packet makes QIF handoff-ready for independent reviewers, AI agents, and audit harnesses without hidden context. Builder: implementation composes existing commands, package-types, inventory, status, review-plan, release-ready, and open-risk signals without external dependencies or a new package type. Guardian: evaluator-packet packages structural evidence only and does not claim semantic truth, independent approval, operational safety, or risk acceptability.
recommendation: Release v0.6.25 after final structural checks, residue scan, commit, tag, and GitHub Release.
